description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for a MongoDB suffix builder used within an Akka persistence plugin. It includes a method to retrieve supported prefixes and an enum for known configuration values with default settings.

classes.name: SuffixBuilderConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration for the MongoDB suffix builder, including method to get supported prefixes and an enum of known configuration values.

classes.name: SuffixBuilderConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of specific configuration keys along with their default values for the suffix builder.

methods.name: getSupportedPrefixes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported prefixes for MongoDB collection name suffixes.
